text:
erin: FWIW i hit a crash running the python quickstart async snippet in the onboarding guide. stacktrace says AttributeError on __aenter__ for the client. docs page: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/python/quickstart

dev-docs: can you paste the snippet you used?

erin: copied straight from the page under "async context manager":
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient

async def main():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=MY_KEY) as client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(model='open-redwood/r1', messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hey"}])
        print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

erin: error: ``AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute '__aenter__'``

pavel: aha. we used to support async context manager semantics but removed it in the v1 refactor. the docs still show the old pattern. should be `client = RedwoodClient(...); await client.connect()` in the new API, or just plain `RedwoodClient()` for the high-level convenience shim.

alex: i also noticed the quickstart's sample-app link 404s (points to python-quickstart-sample-app repo). the example moved into the monorepo under `examples/python/quickstart` last quarter.

dev-docs: thanks. i've opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1091 to track this. proposal: replace the context-manager snippet with two minimal variants and add a tiny note explaining the compatibility break and how to call `await client.close()` for explicit cleanup.

erin: can we also add a small lint/test in docs CI that imports the quickstart file and verifies it runs (with a stubbed transport)? this would have caught the missing dunder method earlier.

qa-bot: suggesting a lightweight smoke job: run the quickstart module under pytest with a fixture that monkeypatches network calls. i can open a PR for the CI step.

pavel: +1. also want to make the typing story clearer: we export both `RedwoodClient` and `TypedRedwoodClient` in the package but docs only show the bare class. add a short `from redwood import TypedRedwoodClient  # for IDE hints` example.

alex: i will update the sample-app URL in the quickstart and replace the context-manager snippet. will add a short changelog line about the removed context-manager support so downstream users aren't surprised. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/391 (WIP)

erin: great. ping me once CI smoke is in place and i'll re-run the onboarding checklist. thanks! :thumbsup:
